enzyme-linked immunospot assay.sample_type: freshly isolated peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC)
enzyme-linked immunospot assay.readouts: IFNγ spot-forming cells per million PBMC in response to Ag85A peptide pools and PPD; spots counted on an ELISpot reader

evidence.quote: IFNγ ELISpot assays were performed on freshly isolated PBMC from all 24 subjects at screening and at 1, 2, 4, 12 and 24 weeks post-vaccination, using the Human IFNγ ELISpot (ALP) kit (Mabtech).

flow cytometry assay.readouts: IFNγ, TNFα and IL2 production by CD4+ and CD8+ T cells after PPD or 85A peptide stimulation; CD4+ T cell surface expression of chemokine receptors CCR4, CCR6, CCR7 and CXCR3; cells acquired on a flow cytometer

evidence.quote: Stained cells were immediately acquired using an LSR-II (Becton Dickinson).

enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay.readouts: anti-r85A IgG, background-subtracted optical density at 405 nm

evidence.quote: Anti-r85A IgG was measured in serum samples collected at week 0, 2, 4 and 24.
